reason: College and campus-related problems are normally handled by the relevant department, HOD, student affairs office, or administration.
steps: Write a short description of the problem.
Collect relevant evidence such as photos, messages, or documents.
Submit the complaint to the appropriate college grievance authority.
Keep the complaint acknowledgement or reference number.

authority: Food Safety Authority / Local Food Safety Department
reason: Food quality, hygiene, and suspected food-safety problems should be reported to the responsible food-safety authority.
official_channel: FSSAI / State Food Safety Complaint Channel
steps: Keep the bill, order details, and photos if available.
Record the restaurant or hotel name and location.
Submit the complaint through the appropriate official food-safety channel.

reason: Suspected crimes, threats, theft, violence, and similar matters should be directed to the appropriate police authority.
steps: If there is immediate danger, contact emergency services first.
Record the important facts, date, time, and location.
Use the appropriate official police complaint channel.

reason: Civic infrastructure and public-service issues are generally handled by the relevant municipal or government department.
official_channel: Local Municipal / State Public Grievance Portal
steps: Take a photo if it helps show the problem.
Submit the complaint to the relevant local authority.
Keep the complaint reference number for follow-up.
